admission_routes.notes: Register in ESSE3 for the programme's Eligibility Check and enrol after a positive assessment.
Uses the standard eligibility-check route, subject to legal-equivalence classification.
Foreign-degree, non-Italian applicants not already resident in Italy apply in the 2026/27 international pre-admission call and, if non-EU, complete Universitaly/visa pre-enrolment.

academic_requirements.summary: A three-year degree/university diploma or suitable equivalent is required, with at least 60 ECTS in MAT, FIS, INF/01 and ING-INF/05: at least 36 ECTS in MAT and at least 15 ECTS in FIS, INF/01 and ING-INF/05. L-35, former class 32, and old-system Mathematics degrees satisfy these curricular requirements automatically. Additional competence assessment applies below 85/110 or when the degree is more than ten years old; the committee may require an interview. The non-EU-abroad pre-admission call instead describes a foreign bachelor's in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering or another field with strong basic Mathematics training and CGPA at least 75/100.
academic_requirements.eligible_foreign_qualifications: Suitable foreign qualification; for the international pre-admission route, a foreign bachelor's in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering or another area requiring strong basic training in Mathematics.
academic_requirements.minimum_grade_or_gpa: Standard route: additional assessment if final grade is below 85/110. International pre-admission route: CGPA or equivalent at least 75/100.
academic_requirements.curriculum_assessment: The committee verifies curricular requirements and personal preparation and may require an interview.

curricula_tracks.name: Erasmus Mundus MATHS DISC
curricula_tracks.differing_requirements: The joint-master route may have a separate application and selection; it is not treated as the standard UNIVR admission route. [uncertain]

ranking_and_quota.ranking_details: No quota is published for the ordinary eligibility-check route. The international call ranks eligible scholarship/fee-benefit candidates, with eligibility at 70/100 for Mathematics.

selection_components.weight_or_threshold: Curricular requirements mandatory; further assessment below 85/110 or for degrees older than ten years

selection_components.component: International-call CV and relevance, recommendation and motivation letters

selection_components.weight_or_threshold: 0-30 points; organised only at 55/70 pre-interview points
selection_components.notes: Official bilingual table contains an internal discrepancy about the interview sub-score needed for the 70/100 pass threshold. [uncertain]

language_requirements.summary: English at CEFR B2 is required.
accepted_language_certificates: A valid B2-equivalent certificate listed by the UNIVR Language Centre
Other complete B2 documentation subject to committee assessment
certificate_exemptions: Degree certificate records a complete English B2 examination
For the international pre-admission route, a previous degree taught in English
language_requirements.notes: Duolingo is accepted in the international call only for applicants from Iran or Afghanistan.

application_windows.applicant_category: Foreign-degree, non-Italian applicants not resident in Italy

required_documents.document: Identity document; passport personal-data pages for non-EU applicants
Bachelor's degree or enrolment certificate with expected graduation date
required_documents.condition: International-call candidates awaiting graduation must obtain the degree by 30 June 2026.

required_documents.document: English-language transcript of records or Diploma Supplement
required_documents.condition: Should include exams and, where possible, ECTS, weighted average and grading scale.

required_documents.document: CV in English, maximum two pages

required_documents.condition: Scored under the programme-specific international-call criteria.

document_legalisation_translation_rules: After pre-admission, candidates must send an official translation and legalisation of the bachelor's diploma and a Declaration of Value issued by the competent Italian diplomatic office.

entry_exam_or_test.name: Personal-preparation interview
entry_exam_or_test.mode: Interview if required; online for the international-call scholarship/benefit selection
entry_exam_or_test.minimum_score: International call: 70/100 overall; interview offered only to candidates with at least 55/70 from the first two criteria.
entry_exam_or_test.notes: There is no general TOLC/SAT-style entrance exam. The committee may require an interview for ordinary eligibility assessment.

application_fee.notes: Applies to the international pre-admission procedure and is credited against enrolment contributions except for scholarship winners.

tuition_amount_basis: First instalment EUR 358; second and third instalments vary under the university contribution rules and ISEE/ISEE-equivalent calculation.
